newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 18.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Indian Prime Minister Deve Gowda has said his government will extend all-out cooperation in resolving bilateral issues with Bangladesh. "India wants the best relations with Bangladesh," Gowda said during a meeting with Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina in Rome on Sunday.
Fundamentalist Jamaat-e-Islami Bangladesh has cautioned that the party would oppose any bid to give India a trade corridor.
A court on Sunday rejected the bail prayer of former President Hussain Mohammad Ershad in a corruption case.
Opposition leader and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia has reiterated that her Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) will resist "at any cost" the attempt to provide transit facility to India.

The government, in a bid to increase supply of scrips in the share market, has decided to off-load stocks of different companies in the possession of the state-run insurance firm, Sadharan Bima Corporation.
The Chittagong Stock Exchange (CSE) opened a second trading booth on Sunday in the face of phenomenal rise in trade volume over the recent months.
